title: After one hour $$(t=1)$$
text: If $$5$$ people see the post initially, $$t=0$$, how many people have seen the post one hour later?

title: After two hours $$(t=2)$$
text: If $$10$$ people have seen the post after one hour, how many will see the post after $$2$$ hours?

title: After $$t$$ hours
text: We see that initially, $$5$$ people have seen the post. When $$t=1$$, $$10=5(2)$$ people have seen the viral post. After two hours, $$5(2)(2)=5\left(2^2\right)$$ people have seen the post. To model this exponentially, we see that after $$t$$ hours, $$5\left(2^t\right)$$ people will have seen the post.
